name: Loro Piana
why: Owns scarcity upstream — vicuña, baby cashmere, record merino.
origin: The Loro Piana family, Piedmont — wool merchants since the early 1800s, the company from 1924.
opview: Positions six generations of fiber obsession as the product itself.

notes.cashmere: vicuña and baby cashmere — it owns the scarcity itself
notes.linen: top-grade European flax in its summer canon
notes.golf: the quiet-luxury golf capsule — cashmere on the back nine
notes.status: the post-Succession cap: quiet luxury made deafening
notes.finbro: the senior private-equity uniform: the quarter-zip, the Summer Walk loafers, the cap
notes.boat: The Superyacht Regatta carries the house name, and the sailing line is a standing part of the collection rather than a summer capsule. The nautical claim is earned rather than borrowed.
notes.racquet: A grass-court register cut in mill-owned cloth. Sport as setting rather than as exertion.
notes.ital: Six generations of the family at the Quarona mill before LVMH bought control in 2013. The house buys its own fibre at source, which is why the Italianness runs further back than the garment.

cities: Boutiques in luxury metros · Mitchells, Wilkes Bashford, Mario's
